lines.english: Can I see the room?
lines.speaker: GUEST

lines.amharic: በእርግጥ! ይህ ክፍል መታጠቢያ ቤት እና ቲቪ አለው።
lines.english: Of course! This room has a bathroom and a TV.
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
lines.transliteration: ba-irigit! yih kifil matatabiya bet inna tivi allaw.

lines.english: It's nice. I want this room.
lines.speaker: GUEST

lines.english: Show me your passport. Here is your key.
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST

lines.amharic: አመሰግናለሁ። ሙቅ ውሃ ቀኑን ሙሉ አለ?
lines.english: Thank you. Is there hot water all day?
lines.speaker: GUEST
lines.transliteration: ameseginalehu. muk wiha kanun mulu alla?

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ሃያ አራት ሰዓት። መልካም ቆይታ!
lines.english: Yes, twenty-four hours. Enjoy your stay!
lines.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
lines.transliteration: awo, haya arat saat. melkam koyita!

lines.amharic: እንኳን ደህና መጡ! ለስንት ሰው ቦታ?
lines.english: Welcome! A table for how many?
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: inkuan dahna mattu! la-sint saw bota?

lines.english: For two people. Do you have a menu in English?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ይቅርታ፣ በእንግሊዝኛ የለንም። ዛሬ ምን አለን ልበልዎ።
lines.english: Sorry, not in English. Let me tell you what we have today.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: yikirta, ba-ingilizinya yallanim. zare min allan libalwo.

lines.english: OK. Do you have doro wat?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: አዎ! ዶሮ ወጥ፣ ጥብስ፣ ሽሮ፣ እና በያይነቱ አለ።
lines.english: Yes! We have doro wat, tibs, shiro, and the mixed platter.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: awo! doro wat, tibs, shiro, inna bayayinatu alla.

lines.amharic: በያይነቱ እፈልጋለሁ። ስጋ አልበላም — የጾም ምግብ አለ?
lines.english: I want the mixed platter. I don't eat meat — do you have fasting food?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: bayayinatu ifaligalahu. siga alballam — ya-tsom migib alla?

lines.amharic: አዎ! የጾም በያይነቱ ጥሩ ነው። ሽሮ፣ ምስር ወጥ፣ አትክልት።
lines.english: Yes! The fasting platter is great. Shiro, lentil stew, vegetables.
lines.speaker: WAITER
lines.transliteration: awo! ya-tsom bayayinatu tiru naw. shiro, misir wat, atikilt.

lines.amharic: ጥሩ! እሱን ይምጣ። ለመጠጥ ሁለት አምቦ ውሃ።
lines.english: Great! Bring that. For drinks, two Ambo waters.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: tiru! issun yimta. la-matat hulat Ambo wiha.

lines.english: Are you satisfied?
lines.speaker: WAITER

lines.english: Yes, very delicious! The bill, please.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. I need medicine.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. What's the problem?
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST

lines.english: I have a cold. I have a cough.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Do you have a fever?
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ትንሽ ትኩሳት አለ። ራሴንም ያመኛል።
lines.english: Yes, a slight fever. My head also hurts.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER
lines.transliteration: awo, tinish tikusat alla. rasenim yamanynal.

lines.amharic: እሺ። የሳል መድሐኒት እና አስፕሪን እሰጥሃለሁ።
lines.english: OK. I'll give you cough medicine and aspirin.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: ishi. ya-sal madhanit inna asprin isatihalahu.

lines.english: How many times a day?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ሦስት ጊዜ በቀን ከምግብ በኋላ። ብዙ ውሃ ጠጡ።
lines.english: Three times a day after meals. Drink lots of water.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: sost gize ba-kan ka-migib bahuwala. bizu wiha tat'u.

lines.english: How much is it?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: መቶ ሃምሳ ብር ነው። ብዙ እረፍ። ደህና ይሁኑ።
lines.english: It's 150 birr. Rest a lot. Get well.
lines.speaker: PHARMACIST
lines.transliteration: mato hamsa birr naw. bizu iraf. dahna yihunu.

lines.english: Hello. I want to change money.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Hello. What kind of currency?
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.english: I have dollars. What's the exchange rate?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: ዛሬ አንድ ዶላር ሃምሳ ስድስት ብር ነው።
lines.english: Today one dollar is fifty-six birr.
lines.speaker: TELLER
lines.transliteration: zare and dolar hamsa sidist birr naw.

lines.english: OK. I'd like to change two hundred dollars.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: A passport is needed. Show me your passport.
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.english: Here's my passport. Will you give me a receipt?
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ደረሰኝ እሰጥዎታለሁ። ይጠብቁ — ገንዘብዎ እነሆ።
lines.english: Yes, I'll give you a receipt. Please wait — here is your money.
lines.speaker: TELLER
lines.transliteration: awo, darasany isatiwotalahu. yitabiku — ganzabwo inaho.

lines.english: Thank you.
lines.speaker: CUSTOMER

lines.english: Keep the receipt safe. Goodbye.
lines.speaker: TELLER

lines.amharic: ዛሬ ማታ የት እንሂድ? መዝናኛ እፈልጋለሁ!
lines.english: Where shall we go tonight? I want entertainment!
lines.speaker: PERSON A
lines.transliteration: zare mata yat inhid? maznanya ifaligalahu!

lines.amharic: ጥሩ አዝማሪ ቤት አውቃለሁ። የባህል ጨዋታ አለ።
lines.english: I know a good azmari bet. There's traditional entertainment.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: tiru azmari bet awikalahu. ya-bahil chawata alla.

lines.english: What is an azmari bet?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: ባህላዊ ሙዚቃ ቤት ነው። ማሲንቆ እና ክራር ይጫወታሉ።
lines.english: It's a traditional music house. They play masinko and krar.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: bahilawi muzika bet naw. masinko inna kirar yichawatalu.

lines.english: Great! What's the entry fee?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: መግቢያ ነጻ ነው። መጠጥ ብቻ ታዛዝ።
lines.english: Entry is free. You just order drinks.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: magbiya natsa naw. matat bicha tazaz.

lines.amharic: ይህ ዳንስ ከየት ነው? በጣም ጎበዝ ዳንሰኛ!
lines.english: Where is this dance from? What a talented dancer!
lines.speaker: PERSON A
lines.transliteration: yih dans kayat naw? batam gobaz dansanya!

lines.amharic: ይህ እስክስታ ነው — የአማራ ባህል ነው። በትከሻ ይደንሳሉ።
lines.english: This is eskista — it's Amhara culture. They dance with their shoulders.
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: yih iskista naw — ya-Amara bahil naw. ba-tikasha yidinsalu.

lines.english: Let me try too! Is it hard?
lines.speaker: PERSON A

lines.amharic: ቀላል ነው! ና! በጣም ቆንጆ ጨዋታ ነው ዛሬ!
lines.english: It's easy! Come on! It's such a great show tonight!
lines.speaker: PERSON B
lines.transliteration: kalal naw! na! batam konjo chawata naw zare!

lines.english: Excuse me! Help me! I've lost my bag.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.english: Calm down. What happened? Where did you lose it?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.amharic: ታክሲ ውስጥ ረሳሁት ይመስለኛል። ፓስፖርቴ ውስጡ ነው።
lines.english: I think I left it in a taxi. My passport is inside.
lines.speaker: TOURIST
lines.transliteration: taksi wist rasahut yimeslanynal. pasporte wistu naw.

lines.english: What kind of bag is it? What color?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.english: It's a black bag. It's small.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.english: What's inside it?
lines.speaker: OFFICER

lines.english: A passport, money, and a phone.
lines.speaker: TOURIST

lines.amharic: የፖሊስ ሪፖርት እንሞላለን። ኤምባሲዎንም ማነጋገር አለብዎት።
lines.english: We'll fill out a police report. You should also contact your embassy.
lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.transliteration: ya-polis riport inimolalan. embasiwonm managagar allabwot.

lines.amharic: ኤምባሲዬ የት ነው? ስልክ መደወል እችላለሁ?
lines.english: Where is my embassy? Can I make a phone call?
lines.speaker: TOURIST
lines.transliteration: embasiye yat naw? silik madawal ichilalahu?

lines.amharic: አዎ፣ እዚህ ስልክ አለ። ደረሰኝ እሰጥዎታለሁ። ተስፋ አታቋርጡ።
lines.english: Yes, there's a phone here. I'll give you a receipt. Don't lose hope.
lines.speaker: OFFICER
lines.transliteration: awo, izzih silik alla. darasany isatiwotalahu. tasfa atakwarit'u.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: እንኳን ደህና መጡ፣ እባክዎ ይቀመጡ። ስለ ራስዎ ትንሽ ይንገሩኝ።
lines.transliteration: enkuan dehna metu, ebakwo yiqemetu. sile raswo tinish yingeruny.
lines.english: Welcome, please have a seat. Tell me a little about yourself.

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.amharic: አመሰግናለሁ። ስሜ ሳሙኤል ነው። ለአምስት ዓመት እንደ አካውንታንት ሠርቻለሁ።
lines.transliteration: amesegnalehu. sime samuel new. le'amist amet ende akauntant serchalehu.
lines.english: Thank you. My name is Samuel. I have worked as an accountant for five years.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ። በእኛ ድርጅት መሥራት ለምን ይፈልጋሉ?
lines.transliteration: betam tiru. be'inya dirijit mesrat lemin yifeligalu?
lines.english: Very good. Why do you want to work at our company?

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.amharic: እኔ እንደማስበው ድርጅትዎ በፍጥነት እያደገ ነው፣ አዲስ ነገር መማር እፈልጋለሁ።
lines.transliteration: ine endemasbew dirijitwo befitnet iyadege new, adis neger memar efeligalehu.
lines.english: In my opinion your company is growing fast, and I want to learn new things.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: አሁን ባለዎት ሥራ ኃላፊነትዎ ምንድን ነው?
lines.transliteration: ahun balewot sira halafinetwo mindin new?
lines.english: What are your responsibilities in your current job?

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.amharic: ወርሃዊ ሪፖርት አዘጋጃለሁ፣ በጀቱንም አስተዳድራለሁ። ቀላል አይደለም፣ ግን እወደዋለሁ።
lines.transliteration: werhawi riport azegajalehu, bejetunim astedadralehu. qelal aydelem, gin ewedewalehu.
lines.english: I prepare monthly reports and manage the budget. It isn't easy, but I like it.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: ጥሩ። ይህ ሥራ አንዳንዴ ጉዞ ይጠይቃል። ለእርስዎ ችግር ይሆናል?
lines.transliteration: tiru. yih sira andande guzo yiteyiqal. le'erswo chigir yihonal?
lines.english: Good. This role will sometimes require travel. Would that be a problem for you?

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.english: No, it won't be a problem. I can travel.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.english: How much salary do you expect?

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.amharic: በወር ሃያ ሺህ ብር ገደማ እጠብቃለሁ፣ ግን መደራደር እችላለሁ።
lines.transliteration: bewer haya shih bir gedema etebiqalehu, gin medarader echilalehu.
lines.english: I expect about twenty thousand birr a month, but I can negotiate.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.english: Okay. We will give you an answer next week.

lines.speaker: Samuel
lines.english: Thank you very much. I look forward to your reply.

title: A VISIT TO THE DOCTOR (Describing Symptoms)

lines.speaker: DR. TESFAYE
lines.amharic: ጤና ይስጥልኝ። እባክዎ ይቀመጡ። ዛሬ ምን ሆነዎት?
lines.transliteration: t'ena yist'iliny. ibakwo yiqemet'u. zare min honewot?
lines.english: Hello. Please have a seat. What's the matter with you today?

lines.speaker: MARTA
lines.amharic: ከትናንት ጀምሮ ራሴን በጣም ያመኛል፣ ትኩሳትም አለብኝ።
lines.transliteration: katinant jemiro rasen bet'am yamenyal, tikusatim alabiny.
lines.english: Since yesterday my head has been hurting a lot, and I also have a fever.

lines.speaker: DR. TESFAYE
lines.english: OK. Do you have a cough or a cold?

lines.speaker: MARTA
lines.amharic: ትንሽ ሳል አለኝ፣ ግን ጉንፋን አይመስለኝም። ጉሮሮዬንም ያመኛል።
lines.transliteration: tinish sal alany, gin gunfan ayimeslenyim. gororoyenim yamenyal.
lines.english: I have a slight cough, but I don't think it's a cold. My throat hurts too.

lines.speaker: DR. TESFAYE
lines.english: Let me check your temperature. Have you taken any medicine?

lines.speaker: MARTA
lines.amharic: ገና ምንም አልወሰድኩም። መጀመሪያ እርስዎን ማማከር ፈለግኩ።
lines.transliteration: gena minim alwesedkum. mejemeriya irswon mamaker felegku.
lines.english: I haven't taken anything yet. I wanted to consult you first.

lines.speaker: DR. TESFAYE
lines.amharic: ጉንፋን ብቻ ነው የሚመስለኝ። ብዙ ውሃ ይጠጡ፣ በደንብም ያርፉ።
lines.transliteration: gunfan bicha naw yemimesleny. bizu wiha yit'et'u, bedenbim yarfu.
lines.english: It seems to me it's just a cold. Drink plenty of water, and rest well.

lines.speaker: MARTA
lines.amharic: እሺ። መድሃኒት ያስፈልገኛል? ወደ ሥራስ መቼ መመለስ እችላለሁ?
lines.transliteration: ishi. medhanit yasfelgenyal? wede siras meche memeles ichlalehu?
lines.english: OK. Do I need medicine? And when can I go back to work?

lines.speaker: DR. TESFAYE
lines.amharic: አሁን ጠንካራ መድሃኒት አያስፈልግዎትም። ትኩሳት ካለ ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ። ከሁለት ወይም ሦስት ቀን በኋላ ይሻልዎታል።
lines.transliteration: ahun t'enkara medhanit ayasfelgiwotim. tikusat kale parasitamol yiwsedu. kehulet weyim sost qen behwala yishaliwotal.
lines.english: You don't need strong medicine now. If you have a fever, take paracetamol. After two or three days you'll feel better.

lines.speaker: MARTA
lines.english: Thank you very much, doctor. If I don't feel better, I'll come back.

title: At the Bank: Opening an Account and Changing Money

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.english: Hello, I would like to open a new account.

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.english: Welcome. Do you have an ID?

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.english: Yes, I have brought my ID.

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.amharic: ጥሩ። ሂሳብ ለመክፈት ቢያንስ መቶ ብር ያስፈልጋል።
lines.transliteration: tiru. hisab lemekfet biyans meto birr yasfeligal.
lines.english: Good. To open an account you need at least one hundred birr.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.english: Okay. Is there a monthly fee?

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.amharic: የለም፣ ወርሃዊ ክፍያ የለም። አገልግሎቱ ነጻ ነው።
lines.transliteration: yelem, werhawi kifya yelem. agelgilotu netsa new.
lines.english: No, there is no monthly fee. The service is free.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: ጥሩ። ዶላር መመንዘርም እፈልጋለሁ። የዛሬ ምንዛሬ ስንት ነው?
lines.transliteration: tiru. dolar memenzerim efeligalehu. yezare minzare sint new?
lines.english: Great. I also want to change dollars. What is today's exchange rate?

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.amharic: ዛሬ አንድ ዶላር ሃምሳ ሰባት ብር ነው። ስንት ይመነዝራሉ?
lines.transliteration: zare and dolar hamsa sebat birr new. sint yimenezralu?
lines.english: Today one dollar is fifty-seven birr. How much will you change?

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: ሁለት መቶ ዶላር እመነዝራለሁ። ምንዛሬው ጥሩ ይመስለኛል።
lines.transliteration: hulet meto dolar emenezralehu. minzarew tiru yimeslegnal.
lines.english: I will change two hundred dollars. The rate seems good to me.

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.amharic: እሺ። እባክዎ ትንሽ ይጠብቁ፣ ገንዘቡን አዘጋጃለሁ።
lines.transliteration: eshi. ebakwo tinish yitebbequ, genzebun azegajalehu.
lines.english: Alright. Please wait a moment; I will prepare the money.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.amharic: አመሰግናለሁ። ትናንት በሌላ ባንክ ብዙ ጊዜ ጠበቅሁ።
lines.transliteration: amesegnalehu. tinant belela bank bizu gize tebbeqhu.
lines.english: Thank you. Yesterday I waited a long time at another bank.

lines.speaker: Solomon
lines.english: I'm sorry about that. Here it won't take long.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.amharic: ሰላም፣ ቤቱ ለኪራይ ነው ብዬ ሰማሁ። ማየት እችላለሁ?
lines.transliteration: selam, betu lekiray new bye semahu. mayet ichlalehu?
lines.english: Hello, I heard this house is for rent. Can I see it?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: አዎ፣ ክፍት ነው። ሁለት መኝታ ቤትና አንድ ሳሎን አለው።
lines.transliteration: awo, kift new. hulet megnta betina and salon alew.
lines.english: Yes, it's available. It has two bedrooms and one living room.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.english: That's good. How much is the rent?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: በወር አስራ አምስት ሺህ ብር ነው። ውሃና መብራት አልተካተቱም።
lines.transliteration: bewer asra amist shih bir new. wuhana mebrat altekatetum.
lines.english: It's 15,000 birr a month. Water and electricity are not included.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.amharic: ትንሽ ውድ ነው። ዋጋውን መቀነስ ይቻላል?
lines.transliteration: tinish wud new. wagawun meqenes yichalal?
lines.english: That's a bit expensive. Can the price be lowered?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: ይቅርታ፣ ዋጋው አይቀነስም። ግን ቤቱ ንጹህና ሰፊ ነው።
lines.transliteration: yiqirta, wagaw ayiqenesim. gin betu nitsuhina sefi new.
lines.english: Sorry, the price can't be lowered. But the house is clean and spacious.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.english: When can I move in?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: It will be available starting next month.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.amharic: እሺ። የሦስት ወር ኪራይ አስቀድሜ መክፈል አለብኝ?
lines.transliteration: eshi. yesost wer kiray asqedime mekfel alebign?
lines.english: Okay. Do I have to pay three months' rent in advance?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: Yes, and we'll also sign a contract.

lines.speaker: Aster
lines.amharic: በጣም ጥሩ። ነገ መጥቼ ውሉን እፈርማለሁ።
lines.transliteration: betam tiru. nege metiche wulun eferemalehu.
lines.english: Very good. I'll come tomorrow and sign the contract.

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: Okay, I'll wait for you tomorrow. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: Yonas
lines.english: placeholder

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: ሰላም ሳራ፣ ያለፈውን ቅዳሜና እሁድ እንዴት አሳለፍሽ?
lines.transliteration: selam Sara, yalefewn qidamena ihud endet asalefsh?
lines.english: Hi Sara, how did you spend last weekend?

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.amharic: በጣም አስደሳች ነበር። ቅዳሜ ጠዋት ከጓደኞቼ ጋር ወደ ገበያ ሄድኩ።
lines.transliteration: betam asdesach neber. qidame tewat kegwadegnoche gar wede gebeya hedku.
lines.english: It was very enjoyable. Saturday morning I went to the market with my friends.

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: Nice! What did you buy?

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.amharic: አዲስ ልብስና ጫማ ገዛሁ። ከዚያ ምሳ በአንድ ምግብ ቤት በላን።
lines.transliteration: addis lbsna chama gezahu. kezia msa be'and migb bet belan.
lines.english: I bought new clothes and shoes. Then we ate lunch at a restaurant.

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: And what did you do on Sunday?

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.amharic: እሁድ ብዙ አልወጣሁም። ቤት ውስጥ አረፍኩ እና ፊልም አየሁ።
lines.transliteration: ihud bzu alwetahum. bet wst arefku ena film ayehu.
lines.english: On Sunday I didn't go out much. I rested at home and watched a movie.

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: ጥሩ ነው። እኔ ደግሞ ቅዳሜ እግር ኳስ ተጫወትኩ።
lines.transliteration: tru new. ine degmo qidame egr kwas techawetku.
lines.english: That's good. I, for my part, played football on Saturday.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.english: Did you (all) win?

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.english: Yes, we won! But I got very tired.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.amharic: የሚቀጥለው ሳምንት አብረን የሆነ ቦታ ብንሄድ ጥሩ ነው ብዬ አስባለሁ።
lines.transliteration: yemiqetlew samint abren yehone bota bnhed tru new bye asbalehu.
lines.english: I think it would be nice if we went somewhere together next week.

lines.speaker: Dawit
lines.amharic: ጥሩ ሀሳብ ነው! የሚቀጥለው ቅዳሜ ወደ ፓርክ እንሄዳለን።
lines.transliteration: tru hasab new! yemiqetlew qidame wede park enhedalen.
lines.english: Good idea! Next Saturday we'll go to the park.
